messages:
Maria: Hi all — I addressed the review comments on PR #4321 and split the allocator rotation logic into a smaller function. PTAL when you have a sec. I added a unit that reproduces the eviction-on-rotation ordering we saw in staging and a short note about a perf delta when batch_size > 64. I'll squash before merge once we have LGTM and CI is clean. Planning to target the Tue 09:00 PT canary.

Sam: Nice, thanks. Small question: did you rename the telemetry metric we read in dashboards? I left an inline comment about the tag name.

Maria: Yep — renamed the metric tag to `kv_alloc_v2` and updated the dashboard queries. Patch snippet:
```
- metric.tags.append('kv_alloc')
+ metric.tags.append('kv_alloc_v2')
```
Also added a test in tests/unit/test_kv_alloc.py to lock down eviction ordering.

Alex: I'll run a quick local smoke and a five-minute load ramp this afternoon. If CI is green and there are no objections, we should merge and schedule the canary.

CI Bot: CI for branch `maria/kv-alloc-fix` — ❌ unit-tests passed, ⚠️ e2e: scheduler_timeout_test failed (flaky). Build #1289. Suggest re-run.

Sam: That scheduler_timeout_test has been noisy this week. Not seeing anything pointing to a regression here. Either add a soft retry in the harness or re-run CI.

Maria: Added a retry wrapper around the assertion in the harness and force-pushed. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/4321/files (tests/harness/scheduler_test.py small change)

Alex: One nit: change the rotation log from `logging.info` to `logging.debug` so it doesn't flood prod logs at high QPS.

Maria: Done, switched to `debug` and pushed. CI re-run queued.

CI Bot: CI for branch `maria/kv-alloc-fix` — ✅ all checks passed. Build #1292.

Alex: LGTM. @Merge Ops Bot can you schedule the canary for Tue 09:00 PT on dedicated-us-west? :+1:

Merge Ops Bot: Canary scheduled for Tue 09:00 PT on cluster `dedicated-us-west` (ticket INF-2021). Canary slot reserved.

Maria: Thanks everyone — I'll be oncall during the canary window and watching logs. Ping this thread if anything weird pops up and I'll roll back or hotfix.
